mask_rule: Relabel the frozen base pairs by a seed-determined direction permutation and assign them to prompts by a seed-determined prompt permutation. Every prompt loses exactly two cells. Every direction is held out at least once and retains at least four training cells. The mask does not read deltas.
decision_rule: PREDICTIVE if on both validation and replication the primary ridge ALS rank-1 model reduces MAE by at least the frozen fraction versus both global-mean and direction-mean, on at least the frozen number of mask seeds, and both pairing permutations leave at most the frozen fraction of that advantage. CONTEXT_DEPENDENT if that holds and leave-one-regime-out MAE exceeds the frozen multiple of blocked rank-1 MAE on both splits. CALIBRATED if predictive fails and few-shot rank-1 reduces MAE by the frozen fraction versus both the one-shot constant and the global mean on both splits, at least the frozen number of directions are not worse than the constant, and the calibration pairing permutation leaves at most the frozen fraction of the advantage. Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Leakage failure forces INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
